title: Sample 17-5: Activity Word List

illustrates.quote: Contracted Activity Word Lists. Word lists with activities centered around the use of the words usually are contracted. Sample key phrases indicating the word list should be contracted include: Write a word that means the same...

blocks.text: Write the word from the box that is associated with each set of terms.
(box continues in print: sign, signature, dream, dreamt, part — abridged in the given braille by a vertical-ellipsis symbol, then the box's own last word)
blocks.features: editorial abridgement, no Emboss ellipsis mechanism

print.notes: An all-caps 'ASSOCIATIONS' heading, directions, a boxed word list (abridged mid-list by the transcriber with a vertical-ellipsis symbol, '444' — no full word list given in either run's own source excerpt), and a lettered activity list.
print.printFeatures: Boxed word list beside directions and a lettered list (source print lays the box out beside the activity, not before it; braille linearises box-then-activity).

braille.notes: Byte-identical between A and B; matches independent re-extraction exactly.

resolution: Both runs (A, B) came from the same model (Gemini Pro via Antigravity, 17 Sep 2026) and are not independent; agreement was treated as no evidence. braille.lines independently re-extracted from references/_text/braille-formats-2016.txt (the line-number field, digits + >=3 spaces, or the fixed left margin measured in ASCII spaces before any U+2800 cell, stripped by counting; U+2800->space; trailing spaces removed). Braille unchanged (A and B agree, matches source). Rule id unchanged ('17.3.3', matches the source's own cross-reference). Modeled with a 'box' block (matching buildModel7/8/12's own nested-box convention) containing the box's own visible words as an ordinary (contracted, per 17.3.3) list, the transcriber's own mid-box abridgement recorded as 'other' (not representable — Emboss has no ellipsis mechanism, matching buildModel8's own established '444' precedent), then a lettered activity list outside the box.
